evidence.initialExplanation: 泣きだした presents onset. It does not prove that every onset with だす is involuntary, or that rain would become intentional with はじめる.
evidence.revisedExplanation: 泣きだした presents the onset of crying. 泣きはじめた can also describe its beginning; choosing だす does not by itself prove whether this child's crying was deliberate.
